notes: From T8 to T18 the Runner clicked for credits up to 46 with 5 cards in grip and never played them, while the Corp sat at 0-3 credits and scored FoI (T9), Headline (T13), Post-Truth (T16) and Stoke (T19) from Server 1/3 unchallenged. On T4 it also declined to pay 2 to Loot Box despite having the credits, and it never ran its Sable mark.

The Corp iced HQ on T1 but left R&D open until T5 while the Runner ran it 12 times (Sericulture stolen T4), and T3 was spent on Hedge Fund plus two credit clicks instead of R&D ice. On T9 it dumped all 7 credits into rezzing Ivik, leaving the Server 4 and R&D ice unrezzable, so Hybrid Release (T9) and two Yagi-Udas (T9, T11) were stolen.

From T3 to T15 the Runner clicked for credits nearly every turn, reaching 53, and never installed a breaker suite or ran R&D/HQ. Remastered Edition (T9, T11) and Next Big Thing (T16) were scored from Server 1 uncontested; the T8 Into the Depths hit Capacitor with no breaker.

Clean remote scoring: Fujii (T5), Sericulture (T6) and Sericulture (T11), with Urtica Cipher as a decent trap on T8. Credits sat at 0-2 from T6 on, so the R&D ice was never rezzed and Hybrid Release leaked on T8.

Good aggression early: stole Headline (T2), FoI (T3) and Witch Hunt (T4). After that it kept running HQ through known, unbroken Doomscroll while tagged (T3, T5, T8, T9), losing 3 cards each time (Info Bounty, Sure Gamble, Carmen, Cezve, Debbie), and on T9 it paid to remove a tag right before a run that gave it back.

On T2 Cultivate trashed Project Yagi-Uda into an unprotected Archives, and it was stolen the same turn. With 12-17 credits on T4-T6 the Corp clicked draws and credits into end-of-turn discards, leaving Yagi-Uda and two Sericultures in HQ behind a single Hafrun; those were stolen T4, T6 and T7, and Server 1 sat empty until T7.

Steady R&D pressure through Paywall won the game. However, the T1 Grubber facecheck wasted 3 credits, and from T8 to T11 the Runner ran R&D only once per turn while holding 9-12 credits and clicking for credits. Unity (T4) and the duplicate Gauss (T12) did nothing, and HQ was never revisited despite the Corp discarding every turn.

From T5 to T16 the Runner clicked for credits nearly every turn, reaching 46 with a full grip it never played, and made no runs on R&D/HQ. The Corp advanced and scored Artificial Cryptocrash (T12), Next Big Thing (T15) and Cryptocrash (T18) from Server 4 after one bounce off Klevetnik on T11.

On T2 Neurospike was played with no agenda scored (3 credits for nothing). Agendas stayed in HQ behind one Hafrun (Longevity Serum stolen T3, Hybrid Release T6, Lotus Haze T9), and Lotus Haze was trashed (probably as Anemone's cost on T6) into open Archives and stolen there on T7. Server 2 got two ice on T3 and was never used, and credits sat at 0-4.

On T1 the Corp scored Hybrid Release instead of icing R&D, and Lotus Haze was stolen at once. The game-losing play came on T13, when Mitosis put Lotus Haze and Longevity Serum naked in new Servers 7 and 8 against a Runner on 4 points, even though Servers 2-4 were iced. Neurospike on T10 did nothing.

Scoring through Server 1 behind Hafrun was sound (Longevity T3, Lotus Haze T7, Hybrid T9/T11, Longevity T14). However, R&D was unprotected T1-T3, which gave up 5 points to Finality on T1, and credits never rose above 5, so the R&D ice was never rezzed.

The Runner kept running R&D into F2P without a breaker, so Gauss was bounced and reinstalled for 2 credits about six times (T2, T9, T11, T13, T20, T24). It ran Server 1 with 0-3 credits into Grubber (T14, T15), and on T22 it ran HQ carrying 9 tags without Gauss, feeding Capacitor 9 credits. Living Mural (T19) was installed and never used.

See How They Run was stolen from HQ behind a single Anemone on T2, and the Corp then spent most turns drawing at 0-4 credits with no econ. Hybrid Release went into Server 2 behind one ice and was stolen T10; on T13 it drew three cards at 0 credits and Sisyphus Protocol was taken from HQ for the loss.

The Runner went to 0 credits on T1 (Sang Kancil + Afterimage) and declined to pay Loot Box on T4. On T8 it re-ran Server 2 into the already-seen Behold!, then spent T6-T11 paying 2 credits a click to strip tags. Headline (T9), FoI (T12) and Stoke (T13) were scored from Servers 4 and 5 uncontested, and it never got a Sable mark click.

It won, but recklessly: it ran into known, unbroken Doomscroll while tagged on T7, T11, T12, T14, T15 and T16, taking 3 net damage each time with 0-1 credits and losing Tremolo, Debbie, Daily Casts and others. Carmen (bought T6 for 5 credits) cost 5 per Doomscroll break and was usable only twice, and tags piled up against a Corp holding 8-11 credits.

After rezzing Phoneutria on T1 the Corp lived at 0-3 credits and never played econ; Petty Cash was seen in HQ on T1 and never played. It still fired AU Co's draw-2 into hands that forced discards (T7, T9, T10, T13, T14), and R&D stayed behind a single Diviner, so Flower Sermon (T7), Sericulture (T13) and Fujii (T14) were stolen.

Persistent R&D pressure through Vasilisa won the game. However, the Runner spent a click and 2 credits removing the Vasilisa tag almost every turn (about 12 times), even when the Corp was at 0 credits. It usually ran only once per turn despite 10-14 credits, and Living Mural (T16, on Server 1 ice) and Unity (T12) were installed and never used.

On T3 Neurospike did nothing, and on T4 the Corp put two more ice on an empty Server 1 while Hybrid Release, Fujii and Sericulture sat in HQ behind one Diviner; they were stolen T3, T4 and T7. On T10 it discarded Hybrid Release into unprotected Archives, which the Runner took for the win.

R&D had no ice T1-T4 while the Corp held 12-16 credits and installed Urtica traps instead, giving up 6 points in 12 runs. On T9 it spent all 7 credits rezzing Ivik and then sat at 0 credits T10-T13, discarding the extra AU Co draws, while Yagi-Uda was taken from HQ through unrezzed ice on T13.

Living Mural was installed on T1 for nothing, and on T6 the Runner declined to pay Paywall's 1 credit while holding 20 credits. It then clicked for credits T7-T12 up to 45 without running anywhere but Archives, while Kingmaking/Oracle, Remastered, Oracle Thinktank and Remastered were scored from Server 1.
